villagepax.quest.founding_2: There is nothing to lay the new house's footing with. We need stone.

villagepax.tooltip.marker.hint: Only needed to author your own schematic with a structure block. A finished village has no markers left.
villagepax.greeting.title: Village Pax: Norman villages stand somewhere in the forests.
villagepax.greeting.how: Find their elder and do what he asks — he will hand you a town hall blueprint, and your own colony starts from it.
villagepax.locate.none: No village sites nearby: peoples settle in biomes %s, and none is around.
